title: Figure 20. Functional design of a DNA based logic gate (deoxyribozyme infographic)
description: Illustrated infographic on a dark blue background with three sections: "Output Enzyme" showing a deoxyribozyme with enzyme core, substrate binding region, fluorescent group, and quencher group cleaving a substrate; "Input Sensor" contrasting a "Closed Stem-Loop" and "Open Stem-Loop"; and "Sensor Gate" showing three numbered steps of an input strand activating the enzyme. Captioned "Figure 20. Functional design of a DNA based logic gate."
